title: Pure Dragon Ruler
summary: Pure Dragon Ruler elemental dragon strategy featuring all four original Dragon Rulers and their baby counterparts, powered by the 2025 support wave and generic staples. Completely free from the TCG banlist, the deck cycles FIRE, WATER, WIND, and EARTH dragons from hand and GY to summon Level 7 bodies and rank up into oppressive Rank 7 Dragon Ruler Xyz bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Spectral, Dragon Ruler of Flickers discards itself with a Dragon or LIGHT monster to search two Dragon Ruler monsters from Deck to hand.
Dragon Shrine sends a Dragon from Deck to GY (such as Tidal or Blaster), immediately enabling their GY banish-revival effects.

The baby Dragon Rulers (Burner, Lightning, Reactan, and Stream) discard themselves with a Dragon or matching-Attribute monster to Special Summon their respective adult Dragon Ruler directly from the Deck.

Each adult Dragon Ruler (Blaster, Tempest, Tidal, and Redox) can discard itself alongside another monster to destroy a card, search a Dragon, mill any monster, or revive any monster from the GY respectively.

summary.title: Opening: Spectral, Dragon Ruler of Flickers + Dragon
steps: Activate Spectral, Dragon Ruler of Flickers, discarding itself and another Dragon to search Blaster, Dragon Ruler of Infernos and Tempest, Dragon Ruler of Storms.
Activate Dragon Shrine, sending Tidal, Dragon Ruler of Waterfalls and another Dragon to the GY.
Special Summon Tidal from the GY by banishing Spectral and another monster; trigger Spectral or banished Rulers to search.
Special Summon Blaster from hand by banishing two FIRE or Dragon monsters from your hand or GY.
Overlay Level 7 Tidal and Level 7 Blaster to Xyz Summon Eclipse, Dragon Ruler of Catastrophes (or Chasma, Dragon Ruler of Auroras).

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Eclipse, Dragon Ruler of Catastrophes on Xyz Summon Special Summons an adult Dragon Ruler from your Deck, and detaches a material to negate and banish an opponent's activated Spell or Trap card.
Chasma, Dragon Ruler of Auroras sends a Dragon Ruler from your hand or Deck to the GY as a Quick Effect on either turn to apply that Ruler's discard effect.
Disaster, Dragon Ruler of All Apocalypses overlays directly onto any Dragon Ruler Xyz Monster, attaches Dragon Rulers from GY, and banishes all opponent monsters matching those Attributes.
Blaster destroys any card on the field when discarded, and searches a FIRE Dragon when banished.
Tempest searches any Dragon when discarded, and searches a WIND Dragon when banished.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Dragon Shrine mills Dragons to immediately set up GY banish fodder for adult Rulers.
Nebulus, Dragon Ruler of Mishaps discards itself from hand to Special Summon two banished Dragon Rulers with different Attributes, and revives Eclipse from the GY.
Each adult Dragon Ruler returns to the hand during the opponent's End Phase if Special Summoned, keeping your hand full of discard fodder.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Dragon Link and Tenpai Dragon hybrid variants are excluded to focus exclusively on pure Dragon Ruler mechanics and their 2025 boss monsters.
